#### Assign resilience goal to service group
  
Assign resilience goals to your service group to enable Azure to monitor adherence to key resilience targets and proactively identify areas that require attention.
  
**Potential benefits**: Improve service and application resilience

**Impact:** Medium
  
For more information, see [How to Assign Goals to Your Service Group](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2324915).
